BACK PATCH · D · CONSTRUCTION
!
Two layers: tree in front, back panel behind, joined only in the middle 3 cm at top and bottom, open at the sides. 4 ring-spring snaps 10 mm, antique copper, on the BACK panel. A belt up to 4 cm runs between back panel and front.

LOCATION

FINISHED SIZE

Size 8 × 7.1 cm (6 cm at the sides), curve 5.5 mm top and bottom
Snap grid 6.6 × 4.6 cm, snap centres 0.7 cm from the side edges · cap and socket on the back panel, stud on the jeans with 2 × 2 cm reinforcement inside
Stiff interlining in the patch so the snaps cannot tear out · edges folded and topstitched · no indigo on the linen
Washable by hand on its own: 30 °C, do not wring, dry flat

Please send for approval before the proto: photo of the digitized patch (stitch count) and one embroidered sample on our linen, washed once by hand.
